summary.zh: 把单个 DSH Agent 变成一支工程团队：Markdown 任务池、主 Agent 调度、后台 worker 交付、机器验收（重跑测试、基线比对、测试改弱审计），需求可异步投递，附只读 Web 面板；git 可选。
summary.en: Turn one DSH agent into a small engineering team: a Markdown task pool, a lead agent that dispatches isolated background workers, machine-verified acceptance (test rerun, baseline diff, test-weakening audit), async intake, and a read-only Web dashboard. Git optional.
